name: Sichuan Huiyu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Huiyu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells anti-tumor injection in China and internationally. It offers injection drug products, such as pemetrexed disodium, methrotrexate, docetaxel, azacitidine, oxaliplatin, cyclophosphamide, irinotecan hydrochloride, paclitaxel, bendamustine hydrochloride, decitabine, palonosetron hydrochloride, plerixafor, levetiracetam concentrated solution, amifostine, levofolate calcium, thiotepa, fulvestrant, and milrinone drugs.
